item.title: Towel draped over streetlight, 20th July
item.description:
Someone appears to have draped a towel over the streetlight. This is unsightly, interferes with the light output and also in the event of wet weather this will lead to prolonged exposure of the streetlight to water ingress from the wet towel and cause premature damage to the fitting. If someone has an issue with the light they should get curtains rather than being a selfish knob
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 12, Fairfield Walk, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham
